feature_policy: complete verified training feature prefix available before update one; fresh model, optimizer, RNG and usage counts
training_checks: no native training render or fresh feature extraction
identical initial model and frozen frontend weights across arms
unchanged retained features within each learning curve
one-view 4000-update weights reproduce the previous matched control
complete training-state reference-performance coverage and no held-out membership

evaluation.recipes: same fixed validation state/reference/transfer combinations as the two-view comparison
evaluation.primary: equal-weight mean reference and transfer MR-STFT distance per state
evaluation.selection: lowest complete validation primary mean; declared input order breaks ties, preferring incumbent then fewer updates
planned_comparisons: two minus one at each matched update count
8000 minus 4000 and 16000 minus 4000 within each arm
each candidate minus fixed train-only retrieval
evaluation.uncertainty: paired state bootstrap, 2000 resamples, seed 0; descriptive validation intervals without selection or multiple-comparison adjustment
